title: Mother and Child Portrait, 1930s Sepia Snapshot, USA
description: A late 1930s vintage sepia-toned snapshot depicting a young mother standing on a front lawn holding hands with her young daughter. The woman wears round eyeglasses, a light-colored button-up blouse, dark A-line skirt, and period heels. Behind them stands a Craftsman bungalow style residence with a stone porch pillar. Handwritten names 'Emmalou' and 'Helene' are written in pencil on the back.
